supersedes: narrative_local_v1 (0/303 raw outputs passed; retained unchanged as a negative result)
development_informed: Yes. The format, model choice, and contribution_role check were chosen after inspecting v1 outputs on the same 101 development packets. v2 is not an independent validation.
reason: Larger instruction model in the same family; v1 showed the 1.7B model could not follow format constraints.
format: The model writes only the contribution prose (demo_utils._copilot_prose_prompt). Code adds the factual opening, transfer note, and disclaimer (demo_utils.assemble_narrative). The live demo uses the same format.
validator: scripts/narrative_validation.py with the new clause-level contribution_role check. contribution_direction is evaluated per clause rather than per sentence, which removes false positives for sentences that name both directions. Replay shows that no earlier run outcome changes.
primary: All raw attempts pass all automated checks on the assembled narrative; generation errors, empty outputs, and truncations count as failures.
uncertainty: Profile-cluster bootstrap, seed 13, 10000 draws; repeated greedy generations are not independent samples.
policy: Freeze before generation. Do not tune the prompt on v2 results. Report the result whatever it is; retain v1.
